description: Canonical tool-name mapping for the agentii-investment-intelligence package. Maps legacy prompt tool names and upstream FSI MCP connector references to spec-019 endpoint names. Also documents citation rewrite rules (FR-050) and preflight health-check templates.

system_v2_7._comment: Maps tool names used in references/prompts/system_v2_7.py (the well-tested agentic long-range financial analysis prompt set) to spec-019 endpoint names that agentii-ai/apps/api/ exposes.

upstream_fsi._comment: Maps upstream Daloopa/FactSet/S&P Global/Bloomberg/LSEG MCP connector tool references (used in anthropics/financial-services) to agentii equivalents backed by spec-019.

citation_rewrite_rules._comment: Regex-based rewrites to convert upstream citation formats to the FR-050 v1.0 frozen format: [📄 <ticker> <form> p.<page>](agentii://source/<uuid>?accession=<accession>&page=<page>). The canonical format is validated by scripts/validate-citations.py.

rules.name: daloopa_source_n
rules.note: Daloopa citation format has no direct agentii equivalent without filing context. Port script must reconstruct the citation by joining the upstream source row to an agentii source UUID.

rules.name: factset_bare
rules.note: FactSet references lack enough metadata to construct an FR-050 citation. Port must fail loud.

rules.name: legacy_tuple_row
rules.note: Legacy tuple-row syntax is deprecated; must be expanded to full FR-050 form.

preflight_templates._comment: Reusable MCP health-check snippets for ## Preflight sections in SKILL.md. Both must complete in <2s.

mcp_tool_descriptions._comment: Protocol-sequence position guidance for the 5 critical-path three-layer tools per spec 023 FR-059a. Consumed by spec 019 MCP tools/list generation (FR-119). Descriptions use explicit 'AFTER X, BEFORE Y' language so agents discover the correct call sequence via tools/list without reading external documentation.
mcp_tool_descriptions.search_documents: Layer 1 document discovery. Use FIRST before any page-level operation to identify candidate filings by ticker, form_type, date range. Returns page-based silver records with pre-computed labels for 8-K/6-K filings.
mcp_tool_descriptions.search_sec_filings: Layer 1 filing metadata index for standardized SEC forms (10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, S-1, DEF 14A). Use to discover which filings exist for a ticker and fiscal period before content retrieval.
mcp_tool_descriptions.read_source_outline: Layer 2 page map. Use AFTER document discovery (search_documents/search_sec_filings) and BEFORE read_source_pages. Returns ALL pages' description + keywords WITHOUT loading page_content — scan hundreds of pages' metadata to pinpoint the 3-5 relevant pages. Optional deeper labels (table_titles, views, drivers, metrics) available with include_deep_labels=true.
mcp_tool_descriptions.search_keyword_in_source: Layer 2.5 optional keyword filter. Use AFTER read_source_outline and BEFORE read_source_pages to keyword-filter pages within a known document. Best for narrowing large documents (>50 pages) where the outline returns >10 candidate pages.
mcp_tool_descriptions.read_source_pages: Layer 3 deep read. Use AFTER read_source_outline (and optionally search_keyword_in_source) to load full page_content with [[Table{idx}]] markers for ONLY the pages identified in prior layers. Each page carries a citation_id (UUID+page_index) for FR-050 citation traceability.
mcp_tool_descriptions.search_cross_period: Wraps the full three-layer protocol (Layer 1→2→2.5→3) in parallel across fiscal periods. Use AFTER get_company_fiscal_calendar to resolve period format labels. Each period's sub-agent independently executes the three-layer protocol against its assigned period's documents. Results merged by fiscal_quarter tag.
